explication: Betaflight is embedded flight-controller firmware for multirotor and fixed-wing craft. Its primary runtime path initializes the system and flight-control phases, then repeatedly runs the scheduler; the task table includes real-time gyro, filtering, PID, receiver, and optional sensor work. A separate USB mass-storage mode exposes onboard flash or an SD card through storage callbacks. The README documents additional pilot-facing capabilities, represented as firmware subsystems. Evidence is limited to the supplied excerpts, source index, and README; unsampled subsystem links are omitted.
